notes: Nongtori field Weight_g is measured with the strawberry calyx attached. Therefore Dryad weight_with_calyx is the canonical weight target and weight_without_calyx is auxiliary analysis only. Downloads must pass size/SHA-256 verification. Before APPROVED: run the real datasheet audit, prove image filename to fruit ID join, require complete with-calyx GT, and split strictly by fruit identity so the 22 views of one berry never cross train/validation/test.
